name: ChimpsPrime
summary:
Welcome to ChimpsPrime, the next evolution of primal VR movement. Inspired by the viral hit Gorilla Tag, this fangame cranks up the chaos with futuristic arenas, enhanced mobility, and wild multiplayer modes.

Play as a hyper-evolved chimp and launch yourself through neon-lit jungles, cyber temples, and gravity-defying arenas using only your arms—no buttons, no sticks, just pure skill and instinct.
